transcriptions: ['In the photo, there is a haenyeo (female diver) who seems to be about to enter the water. There’s a woman holding a net, likely intended for catching whatever she will find later. They are characterized by their distinctive black diving suits and equipment, diving into the water without any breathing apparatus to gather seafood. The woman in the photo is wearing a hat and a diving suit while standing in the water, holding a basket with a net attached to it in one hand. This basket is used to store the seafood they collect. Surrounding her are small rocks, clearly indicating that it is a coastal area. The haenyeo culture has also been designated as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity and is considered a representative cultural element of Korea with a long tradition and unique way of life.']
